HediffDef.label: sower's blessing
HediffDef.description: A god of the harvest has blessed these hands. Seed takes where they sow it, and the crop they bring in is heavier than it has any right to be.

HediffDef.label: storm-sense
HediffDef.description: A god of storms has opened this one's ears to the sky. They feel weather coming in their teeth, and the psychic world is louder for them, though they keep their nerve when it roars.

HediffDef.label: hunter's eye
HediffDef.description: A god of the hunt has sharpened this one's eye. Their shots fly truer, and game does not hear them coming.

HediffDef.label: healer's touch
HediffDef.description: A god of healing has blessed these hands. Wounds close cleaner under them, and they work quickly and gently at a bedside.

HediffDef.label: captain's blessing
HediffDef.description: A god of war has marked this one as a fighter worth watching. They strike surer and slip blows better, and pain takes longer to put them down.

HediffDef.label: blessed hand
HediffDef.description: A god of the forge has blessed this hand. Work goes quicker and truer in it, and building most of all.

HediffDef.label: road-luck
HediffDef.description: A god of the road walks with this one. Their feet are quick and the miles short, and traders find themselves giving a better price than they meant to.

HediffDef.label: ferryman's ear
HediffDef.description: A god of the dead has let this one hear the far bank. Grief and terror sit lighter on them, and the quiet of the other side is always near.

HediffDef.label: dream-sight
HediffDef.description: A god of the night has opened this one's dreams. Their sleep is deep and quick, and they wake with the feeling of having been somewhere.

HediffDef.label: warm hearth
HediffDef.description: A god of the hearth has blessed this one's fire. Their cooking is quick and safe, and people sit easier in their company.

HediffDef.label: green hand
HediffDef.description: A god of the wild has blessed this one. Growing things thrive under their hands, and beasts trust them sooner than they should.

HediffDef.label: river-luck
HediffDef.description: A god of the waters keeps this one. Fevers wash out of them like silt, and they move as easily as a current.

HediffDef.label: machine-tongue
HediffDef.description: A god of machines has given this one its language. Problems that stump everyone else come apart in their head like clockwork.

HediffDef.label: hollow gift
HediffDef.description: Something under the gods has given this one an ear for what is beneath the world. They hear it clearly now, and it does not always let them rest.

HediffDef.label: blessing turned sour
HediffDef.description: A trickster's gift has turned in this one's hands. Everything takes a little longer and goes a little wrong, and they can't shake the feeling that someone is laughing.

HediffDef.label: god's mark
HediffDef.description: A god has put its mark on this one, a pale sign on the skin that never fades. It was the price of a gift. People notice it, and some of them look away.

HediffDef.label: god's champion
HediffDef.description: Chosen by a god of war to lead this fight. They will not be easily put down, and their god is watching.

HediffDef.label: calm from the dark
HediffDef.description: Something answered when this one was at the edge, and their mind went still. The calm is cold and complete, and it will not last.
